name: Lost Necklace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here.

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 6 to 8, 1,565 XP in all.

quests.name: Pie for Billy
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.

quests.name: Back to Billy
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.

quests.name: Goldtooth
quests.objectiveText: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
